reason: Old v23 baseline and stress JSON each contain 8 NaN values in net_return and exit_fill_economic for four pending labels. V27 numeric serializer writes null. Original byte-value equality rejected this intended missing-value encoding conversion.
allowed_comparison: Only old float NaN in those two fields on reason=pending,exit_at=null,complete_window=false may normalize to null. All other structure and values must match exactly. Unknown-to-zero or changes to known returns are rejected.
